raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What
Removed accidentally duplicated words ('for for', 'with with') in a comment, two docstrings, and a user-facing error message across four Python files.

## Why
A small, objectively-verifiable improvement (typo) found during a
daily open-source maintenance pass (2026-10-10).

## How verified
Searched python/sglang for repeated adjacent words with ripgrep, then re-read git diff: 5 insertions and 5 deletions, each a pure removal of one duplicated word, with no code logic changed.
